Option Explicit
Public src As Worksheet, calc As Worksheet, held As Range, heldAnchor As Range, member As Range
Sub Bind()
Set src=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
Set calc=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(2)
Set held=src.Range("A1")
Set heldAnchor=calc.Range("B2")
Set member=calc.Range("C3")
End Sub
Function CellState(c As Range) As String
Dim answer As String
answer=c.Address(False,False) & ":" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & ":array=" & CStr(c.HasArray)
If c.HasArray Then answer=answer & ":block=" & c.CurrentArray.Address(False,False) & ":af=" & c.FormulaArray
CellState=answer
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim c As Range, result As String
If src Is Nothing Then Bind
If held Is Nothing Then Bind
result="owner=" & src.Name & ";code=" & src.CodeName & ";heldOwner=" & held.Parent.Name & ";held=" & held.Address(External:=True) & ";mode=" & CStr(Application.Calculation) & ";beforeSave=" & CStr(Application.CalculateBeforeSave)
result=result & ";heldAnchorOwner=" & heldAnchor.Parent.Name & ";heldAnchor=[" & CellState(heldAnchor) & "];heldMemberOwner=" & member.Parent.Name & ";heldMember=[" & CellState(member) & "]"
For Each c In src.Range("A1:B3,D1:E2").Cells
result=result & ";src=[" & CellState(c) & "]"
Next
For Each c In calc.Range("B2:C3,F1").Cells
result=result & ";calc=[" & CellState(c) & "]"
Next
Snapshot=result
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot="SNAPSHOT-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Prepare() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=False
Set src=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set calc=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
calc.Name="Calc"
src.Range("A1").Value2=1
src.Range("A2").Value2=2
src.Range("A3").Value2=3
calc.Range("B2:C3").FormulaArray="=Data!A1:A2*{1,2}"
calc.Range("F1").Formula="=SUM(B2:C3)"
Application.Calculate

Prepare=Snapshot()
Exit Function
Failed:
Prepare="PREPARE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim result As String
Bind
Application.Calculation=-4135
Application.Calculate
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=True
result="before=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
src.Name="O'Brien renamed"
result=result & ";renamed=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
held.Value2=9
result=result & ";edited=[" & Snapshot() & "]"

Probe=result & ";final=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
